propositions: RemoteRef is never constructed in production code; only the frozen dataclass exists without any implementation that populates the instance field

The instance field must be derived from the configured base URL (normalized: scheme dropped, host lowercased, default port dropped, trailing slash dropped, context path retained) and injected at Backend construction time, not resolved at call time

RemoteRef.instance does not prevent local-id collision between same-vendor deployments because _jira_key_to_local_id derives IDs from Jira keys alone, independent of instance; vendor field already separates Cloud from DC
Backend port must declare remote_ref(remote_id: str) -> RemoteRef as a member, with both concrete backends implementing it to return a RemoteRef built from constructor-injected instance state
The test doubles implement remote_ref() while the production port never declared it, creating an asymmetry where contract tests verify against a fake more capable than production code
